title: abrahamaiproject-bit/infra-terraform
body:
# infra-terraform

Terraform modules for Lumen Freight's AWS infrastructure (VPC, EKS, RDS, ElastiCache).

## Environments
- `envs/staging`
- `envs/production`

## Conventions
- Every resource must have `team` and `environment` tags.
- Budget alert set at $4,000/month (added after the September cost spike).
